en: Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town taken from a field outside the built‑up area. In the foreground are cultivated fields and a few detached houses; behind them is a dense cluster of town roofs. On the right stands a large church with a tall spire, and further back in the center are several prominent church towers rising above the townscape. The lower margin is blank except for printed captions identifying the scene and publisher.
